newsitem.title: ITALY: Lower house seen approving Italian budget on Sat.
newsitem.headline: Lower house seen approving Italian budget on Sat.

text.p: Ratification of the government's 1997 budget should be completed by the lower house of parliament on Saturday, chamber speaker Luciano Violante said.
"I believe we will finish (voting) tomorrow because tonight, we won't be able to do it," Violante told reporters.
The government has said it will apply to put the lira back into Europe's Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) once the budget law has been approved by the lower house.
Early on Friday, the lower house approved the core of the three-pronged budget package and has already started voting on the final two sections of the bill.
Political sources had expected ratification to be completed on Sunday, but Violante said he thought the process could be sped up.
Once the lower house has voted on the draft law, it passes for a further reading to the Senate (upper house).
